notes.title: Game redesign!
notes.notes: In this update, we have completely replaced the design with a new one (Main menu has completely changed. Landings have been removed). We apologize to everyone who did not like that it was very similar to the game [i]"A Building Full of Cats"[/i] . We did not try to deceive or offend anyone. We just really liked the idea. We personally apologize to the developers of the "Devcats" studio.
